data.name: Flirt Simulator
data.detailed_description:
Forget Pre-written Options. Write Your Story with Your Own Words. Flirt Simulator is a first-person (FPS), AI-driven life and dating simulation. It completely eliminates traditional dialogue trees and pre-written texts, offering a dynamic world where you communicate with characters in the city using your own words.

Communication Without Limits You are no longer forced to choose from on-screen dialogue prompts. Say whatever you want to the characters you meet, or text them freely from your in-game smartphone. Thanks to advanced AI, every character responds to you in a completely natural, real-time, and context-aware manner. You can flirt with anyone, any way you like.

Advanced NPC Memory and Dynamic Relationships The characters in this city are not just lines of code. Each has their own personality, distinct tastes, and, most importantly, a memory. They remember what you say, the gifts you give, and how you treat them. A character's Love, Desire, and Trust levels towards you evolve organically based entirely on your words and actions.

Life and Character Management To build successful relationships, you must first manage your own life. Take care of your basic needs and work to earn money. Use your hard-earned cash to invest in yourself. Hit the gym to increase your "Muscle" and "Handsomeness" stats. Buy new clothes to boost your "Charisma." The stronger your profile, the better your chances of making a lasting impression.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 4 GB VRAM NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1650 / AMD Radeon RX 570
  • Additional Notes: This game runs a local Large Language Model (LLM) for its systems. A smooth experience and fast text generation directly depend on your GPU's VRAM capacity. For systems with lower VRAM, smaller AI models can be selected from the in-game settings. Installing the game on an SSD instead of an HDD is strictly required.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-12400F / AMD Ryzen 5 5600
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 8 GB VRAM NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 / AMD Radeon RX 6600 XT
  • Additional Notes: This game runs a local Large Language Model (LLM) for its systems. A smooth experience and fast text generation directly depend on your GPU's VRAM capacity. For systems with lower VRAM, smaller AI models can be selected from the in-game settings. Installing the game on an SSD instead of an HDD is strictly required.

content_descriptors.notes: The game contains mature themes, including romantic relationships and implied sexual encounters. Players can engage in romantic interactions and propose intimacy to characters via text input. However, there is no explicit nudity, visible sexual acts, or explicitly erotic text (sexting). Sexual encounters are purely suggestive and are depicted through fade-to-black sequences.
